body.prose: A lot about what we're building here is not aligned with the [OpenLight] vision. It really isn't. We need to get more aligned with [OpenLight]. You're working. I've been pushing you a little bit to just working ahead for results without actually looking at the architecture of what we're doing. The truth is that there is to a working application, such as the website itself, there needs to be a certain level of state. For that, you require a field, you require an engine, to govern it. And you require an interface. Which connects to the engine. So it doesn't make any sense that the engine on the server would directly connect to the interface in the website. Or that is precisely what we think that we can do. But then unlike OpenLight initially, there is now a URL in the client. Because it's a website. Well, I didn't think about the engine to be a web server that serves HTML. Of course, thinking that there is a client. No [SPA?] application. So yeah, we need to get back to basics and consider the architecture of things and what we're doing.
body.title: Back to the architecture
